original_idea.body: CoT Faithfulness Classifier-Sensitivity Robustness Check. Problem: measured faithfulness depends on which classifier/judge decides whether a CoT mentions a factor; no tool quantifies how much a verdict swings across cheap judges. Direction: run multiple cheap judges on fixed (CoT,factor) pairs, measure inter-judge agreement and how much the headline faithfulness rate changes; release as a measurement-robustness diagnostic.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (judge-robustness -> more rigorous faithfulness measurement) but indirect to catastrophic risk.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Run multiple cheap judges on fixed pairs; very accessible, no model access.

low_compute.reasoning: Runs judges on text only, CPU/API.

novelty.reasoning: A cited paper documents exactly this judge-sensitivity; a packaged diagnostic is incremental.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Classifier-sensitivity is already documented; a standalone diagnostic is incremental.
